basic_profile.bio: Hi, I'm Alex from Germany. I have a passion for collecting vinyl records and love immersing myself in various music genres, especially US country music. When I'm not spinning records, you'll find me battling it out in League of Legends or exploring the expansive world of World of Warcraft. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me a flexible schedule to participate in online discussions, mainly during the evenings. I'm currently single, and I find joy in connecting with people globally through Reddit. My English isn't perfect, but I hope that my enthusiasm makes up for it.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have an eclectic set of interests driven by personal experiences and self-learning. My knowledge of mental health issues comes from my own journey with schizophrenia, which also led me to explore related topics. My gaming and music expertise is mainly self-taught, fueled by years of passion and dedication.
